items.title: Vietnam's merchandise trade tops US$1 trillion in Jan–Oct 2026, first time ever
items.summary: Exports US$499.24bn (+27.5% y/y), imports US$511.31bn (+37.4%); October alone posted a US$7.31bn surplus. FDI firms account for 81.2% of exports.

items.title: USDA agribusiness trade mission heads to Ho Chi Minh City, Nov 9–12
items.summary: Vietnam is the 7th-largest US agriculture export market (US$5.6bn in 2025); mission targets food-processing and retail demand.

items.title: Two Vietnamese container ports hold Top-20 spots in World Bank/S&P CPPI
items.summary: Cai Mep cluster ranked 11th, Hai Phong 13th. National container throughput up ~14% y/y in the first five months of 2026.

items.title: Mexico's imports from Vietnam double, transshipment scrutiny rises
items.summary: Jan–Jun imports from Vietnam +103% to US$18.4bn; suspected Chinese tariff-dodging via CPTPP partner Vietnam draws attention.

items.title: Exports accelerate as Vietnam moves towards trade balance
items.summary: Jan–Sep 2026 import-export turnover ≈ US$888bn, +30.4% y/y; FTA utilisation credited for export-mix improvement.

items.title: Cai Mep–Thi Vai: 6.5m TEU in 2024 (+33%), direct US/EU services expand
items.summary: Deep-water cluster now handles ULCVs up to ~214k DWT; only Vietnam complex without draft restriction for 24k-TEU ships.
